title: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base
abstract: arXiv:2611.34529v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base, a mixture-of-experts language model with 80 billion total parameters and approximately 3 billion active parameters per token, trained from scratch at Yandex and released under the Apache 2.0 license. The model combines Kimi Delta Attention with full attention, uses Attention Residuals, and is trained with Muon. Training comprises general pretraining on 17.5 trillion tokens, two context-extension stages, and a dedicated stage for reasoning and agentic interaction. We describe the data collection and augmentation pipelines, evaluation protocols, architectural ablations, and scaling-law experiments. We identify the limitations of held-out training loss as a proxy for downstream performance and introduce an auxiliary loss on mixture-of-experts outputs to stabilize training at the predicted learning rate. translated_title: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base（AliceAI 基础 80B-A3B 基座模型）
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.34529v1 发布类型：新论文。我们推出 AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base，这是一个混合专家语言模型，总参数量为 800 亿，每个词元约有 30 亿激活参数，由 Yandex 从零开始训练，并以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源发布。该模型将 Kimi Delta Attention（Kimi 增量注意力）与全注意力机制相结合，采用注意力残差，并使用 Muon 优化器进行训练。训练过程包括在 17.5 万亿词元上进行的一般预训练、两个上下文扩展阶段，以及一个专门针对推理与智能体交互的训练阶段。我们描述了数据收集与数据增强流程、评估协议、架构消融实验以及缩放定律实验。我们指出了使用留出集训练损失作为下游性能代理指标的局限性，并在混合专家输出上引入了一种辅助损失，以便在预测的学习率下稳定训练。领域特定的数据选择与数据增强提升了事实知识、数学以及编程……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: Yandex 从零训练并开源了总参数 800 亿、每 token 激活约 30 亿的混合专家基座模型，它结合 Kimi Delta Attention 与全注意力并使用 Muon 优化器训练，同时提出在 MoE 输出上引入辅助损失以在预测的高学习率下稳定训练。
en_tdlr: Yandex open-sources AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base, an 80B-total-parameter (about 3B active per token) mixture-of-experts base model that combines Kimi Delta Attention with full attention, is trained with Muon, and introduces an auxiliary loss on MoE outputs to stabilize training at the predicted learning rate.
